title: get_position_in_chat runs the same correlated subquery twice
description: MessageStore::get_position_in_chat runs two separate queries: first an existence check ('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE id = ?1 AND chat_id = ?2'), then the position count query that itself does 'SELECT created_at FROM messages WHERE id = ?2' twice as correlated subqueries. The existence check is redundant because the position count returns 0 whether the message is absent or is the newest message. A single query with EXISTS or a CTE would eliminate one round-trip and the double subquery lookup.
